name: Filen WebDAV
description: Filen WebDAV exposes your Filen cloud storage as a standard WebDAV endpoint running in proxy mode. Each WebDAV client authenticates with its own Filen email and password — the container itself is configured with no Filen account and stores no Filen credentials. Any WebDAV-compatible client — including Finder, Windows Explorer, rclone, and Infuse — can mount the share directly.

notes.text: Each WebDAV client authenticates with its own Filen email and password (formatted as password=<password>&twoFactorAuthentication=<code> if 2FA is enabled). The container's server.js has no Filen account configured.

Credentials are sent via HTTP Basic Auth. HTTPS is not enabled by default — plain HTTP is fine on a trusted LAN, but place a TLS-terminating reverse proxy (nginx, Caddy, or NPM) in front before exposing this to an untrusted network.

Not currently eligible for upstream community-scripts/ProxmoxVED submission: FilenCloudDienste/filen-webdav has around 140 GitHub stars, well under the project's 600+ star requirement for new scripts. This script is intended for fork-only / personal use until that changes.
